title: Caterpillar applies decades of industrial automation lessons to everyday AI deployment
friendlyTitle: Caterpillar brings AI from autonomous mines into daily work
summary: Caterpillar is extending experience from autonomous mining into technician support, digital twins and internal software work. Its field assistant uses voice and proprietary machine data to retrieve repair procedures, troubleshoot equipment and identify likely parts near the job site.
friendlySummary: Caterpillar is using its automation experience for repair assistants, factory simulations and software work. Technicians can ask by voice for repair steps and parts information beside a machine.
whyItMatters: The company’s approach starts with bounded jobs, specialist data and real operating environments rather than a general chatbot. Businesses adopting AI can borrow that sequence: choose a costly workflow, connect trustworthy domain information and measure whether the tool improves actual work.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Useful workplace AI often begins with one clear job and reliable company data, not a chatbot that tries to do everything.
